our_interpretation: The surrounding US–China discussion makes this a forecast about national capability advantages.
The ordinary reading is that neither country will establish a large capability lead that persists through successive competitive model releases.
No numerical capability threshold, duration, or deadline is supplied. Do not manufacture one.
The preceding sentence's continuation-of-trends proviso is contextual; this extracted assertion supplies no separately measurable antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Successive independent evaluations show only small national capability gaps that rivals repeatedly close. A finite record can support the trend without conclusively establishing the unrestricted future claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independent evaluations establish a substantial national capability advantage that remains unmatched through successive meaningful rival releases, beyond ordinary release-cycle fluctuations.
